_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 88 in the 16:03 run), SELECT MELEE WEAPON. Melee has no CUSTOMIZE screen, so the art is cropped from the same shot. Melee reports Hit Delay and Damage instead of the primary-weapon stat block, and has no trait chips.
name: Serrated Blade

description.text: A hooked blade with serrated edge. Attacking enemies from the back or while they are prone will initiate a lethal takedown. Increases sprint speed when equipped.
